summary: Roto standings feature fully tested - all backend unit tests (7/7) and API tests (14/14) pass, frontend UI working correctly with all required data-testid attributes, two-row headers, stat/rank/pts columns, totals, and refresh persistence
seed_data_creation: Used existing 'Stat Chasers Roto' league (id=69e46af167999bfb85c39629) with 14 teams
context_for_next_testing_agent: Roto standings feature complete. Test league has 14 teams with 0 stats (all-tied scenario). Unit tests in test_roto_ranks.py verify 12-team distinct-values ranking. API tests in test_roto_standings_api.py verify endpoint responses. Frontend has all required data-testid attributes for automated testing.

backend_api.GET /api/leagues/{id}/roto/standings: Returns categories array with team_stats, points, ranks dictionaries keyed by team_id
backend_api.GET /api/leagues/{id}/roto/matchup: Returns same structure with ranks included
backend_api.POST /api/leagues/{id}/roto/recompute: Works for admin, returns leader info

rank_engine._rank_category: 7/7 unit tests pass - 12-team no-ties produces ranks 1-12 with points 12-1, respects scoring direction, handles ties with split/high tiebreak

frontend_ui.table_structure: Two-row header with category groups (G, A, P, etc.) and sub-headers (Stat, Rank, Pts)
frontend_ui.category_cells: Each team shows stat value, rank number, and awarded points per category
frontend_ui.direction_arrows: Up arrows for higher-is-better categories (all 12 configured categories are higher-is-better)
frontend_ui.aria_labels: Sub-headers have accessible aria-labels like 'Goals Rank', 'Assists Stat'
frontend_ui.total_column: Shows sum of all category points (90.0 for all-tied scenario)
frontend_ui.sorting: Teams sorted by Total points descending
frontend_ui.first_place: Amber highlight and badge on first-place row
frontend_ui.data_testids: All required: roto-standings-table, roto-standings-row-{teamId}, roto-stat-{catKey}-{teamId}, roto-rank-{catKey}-{teamId}, roto-pts-{catKey}-{teamId}, roto-total-{teamId}, roto-cat-header-{catKey}, roto-col-{catKey}-rank
frontend_ui.sticky_columns: # and Team columns remain visible during horizontal scroll

test_data_notes: All 14 teams have 0 season_stats, so all are tied at rank 1 with 7.5 pts each (split tiebreak: avg(1..14)=7.5). Total = 7.5 × 12 categories = 90.0. This is mathematically correct.
